user_story:
As a user, I want to fill out the checkout information form so that I can proceed to the next step of the checkout process. Acceptance criteria: 
1. The form should have fields for 'First Name' (selector: [data-test="firstName"]), 'Last Name' (selector: [data-test="lastName"]), and 'Zip/Postal Code' (selector: [data-test="postalCode"]). 
2. The 'Continue' button (selector: [data-test="continue"]), when clicked with valid inputs, should navigate to the next page. 
3. Submitting the form without filling in any fields should not change the URL and should keep the 'Checkout: Your Information' header (selector: [data-test="secondary-header"]) visible.
